nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is required when the cathode lining of a Hall-Héroult cell is worn-out?
nodes.answer: It needs to be relined with new cathode lining materials.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Water infrastructure|Cathodic protection systems_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is spent potlining (SPL) and how much is generated for every metric ton of aluminum produced?
nodes.answer: Spent potlining (SPL) is the worn-out cathode lining from aluminum production, and it is estimated that approximately 25 kg of SPL is generated for every metric ton of aluminum produced.
